text: The Ruined Castle is an ancient and immense fortress. It was once the heart of the Northern Kingdom, but now is abandoned and decaying. It was built by the king, now known as the Fallen King. The king became greedy, and started accumulating riches, but the weight of his treasure became so heavy that the castle itself collapsed, and all the inhabitants left the castle, with the exception of the King, that from that moment was never seen again. Now the castle has become matter of legends, and is filled with adventurers, explorers and bandits.

The Fallen King was a legendary king who unified the northern continent in the Northern Kingdom. The king was said to be immortal thanks to a wish granted by the Mystic Crown. His kingdom lasted for more than a thousand years. In the last years of his kingdom, however, he became greedy and started accumulating excessive riches, until his own castle collapsed under the weight of his treasure. From that moment, no one has ever seen the King again, and everyone forgot his name. But the king is said to still wander in the castle, like a silent and somber figure.

The Ancient Forest is an immense forest that surrounds the Ruined Castle. This forest has become the destintion of a lot of adventurer, since it's the only way to reach the Ruined Castle. It is a dungerous place, populated by mysterious creatures.
The Mystic Crown is an ancient elven artifact, which origin is lost in time. It is said that the wearer can express a single wish, and the crown would grant it, whatever the wish could be.

The Shadowmancer is an evil sorcerer. He studied the art of Shadow Bending, which grants him immense power. However, it has been corrupted by this power, and has become a shadow himself. He plans to cast a spell that will plunge the entire world into darkness, so he can rule on this shadow world like an eternal king.

Golgi the Goblin is a little goblin adventurer. He is smart, curious, a bit uppish and very greedy. He is however a good companion, and deep inside is selfless and friendly. He wants to go to the ruined castle to retrieve the treasure of the king.

Irina the Scholar is a shy girl, who is travelling around the world to complete her apprenticeship. She is very knowledgable, and has studied all the fields of knowledge, from history to nature. She is also a skilled mage. She is shy, but when necessary she shows a strong determination. She wants to explore the ruined castle to gain ancient lost knowledge.

Miriam the Warrior is an energic girl in search of adventures. She fled her home to become a warrior and an adventurer. She is very confident, and she is also a skilled warrior. She wants to put under the test her combat skills.

Roland the Prince is nobleman. He is not fit for adventure at all. He is fussy, proud and egocentric. He also has no real fighting or survival skills. However he as a great charisma and knows his way with people. He left his family and his palace to prove that he can be independent.

Marcus the Explorer is a brave, expert explorer and survivalist. He is an orphan, and so has always lived alone. He escaped from the orphanage when he was 12, and became an explorer and adventurer. Now that he cumulated years of experience, he wants to explore the Ruined Castle, the most legendary of all dungeons. He is an half-elf, which is a really uncommon thing.

The Mushroom Wastes are the central area of the Ancient Forest. It is a desolate and dangerous place, where the sunlight barely reaches the ground. However, the mushrooms that grow in this area emit a otherworldly, blueish light, which allows visibility. The true nature of this mushrooms is unknown, but they are said to be parasitic, and to feed on the life energy of the creatures they infest.

The Pale One is a mysterious being that inabiths a small dark cave in the oldest part of the Ancient Forest. It's goals are unkwon, but the stench of blood that surrounds the cave suggests that it has not good intentions. However, it is willing to help adventurers that pass by, if they spark its interest.

The Shadowmancer appears like an extreamely skinny creature. His skin is pitch black, like a shadow. His eyes are two bright points inside the darkness of his face. He has no facial features except for his two bright eyes. He wears sumptuous wizard robes, and a three pointed crown on his head.

Alken the Mad Knight is a legendary warrior, at the service of the Fallen King. He was said to be so strong that he was able to defeat entire armies alone. He wears an heavy armor, and fights with a greatshield and a greatsword. No one has never seen his face, or heard his voice. He never takes off his armor, and never speaks.
